description: Approve or deny the permission a crew in PERMISSION_PENDING is waiting on (see pendingPermissionRequest on anyforge_get_crew). A tool permission applies for the rest of the run; an MCP write approval decides that one call. Pass approvalId to refuse a decision on a newer request. Requires `approve` scope. Only call when the operator decides.

approvalId.description: The pending request's approvalId, when it has one.

comment.description: Optional reason, kept with the decision.

name: anyforge_decide_crew_permission
title: Decide crew permission
